limitations: True for affine magmas and commutative semigroups (Theorems 2-3); no algorithm is known for the 685 bounded-width order-3 classes outside the structured classes, and bounded width does not give short cycles (the affine quasigroups have long ones).
statement: Every magma automaton with bounded streaming width admits an algorithm computing a cyclic row of length L at time t in time polynomial in L and log t.
title: Bounded streaming width implies a fast-forward
